scenes.say: Ever wondered how websites control where things appear? Let’s break down display and positioning in CSS.

scenes.label: Block
scenes.sub: Block elements start on a new line and stretch across the container.
scenes.say: The display property sets layout style. Block elements start new lines and fill the container.
Positioning controls placement. Static and relative follow the flow. Absolute, fixed, and sticky break free for custom placement.
Display flex turns a container into a flexbox. Its children align and space easily.

scenes.question: Does absolute keep elements in flow?
scenes.right: No, absolute removes elements from the document flow, placing them independently.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Absolute positioning removes elements from the flow. Don’t mix this up.
